Why starting a business used to be out of reach for most people.

Kevin Trudeau looks back 20 or 30 years. The options were buying a franchise or starting from scratch, and in both cases people lacked the capital and the know-how. There was nowhere to learn it.

Kevin explains that today is different. Because of YouTube, there are countless videos teaching how to start and run a business.

What would you learn first if the teacher cost nothing?
